lines.en: Only half my face is left.
I drag my steps down the corridor.

lines.zh: 我的关节裸露在外，咯咯响。
lines.en: My bare joints clack as I move.

lines.zh: 我一步步靠近有光的地方。
lines.en: I move step by step toward the light.

lines.zh: 木板响的时候，我已经近了。
lines.en: When the boards creak, I'm already near.
I walk crooked, but I don't fall.
My fingers scrape along the wall.
I slip past the side of the stage.
Missing a foot, I drag a scrape behind me.
My ears don't move at all.
I step and halt, as if jammed.
I shift toward the door.
I stand in the dark, eyes still lit.
A white eye rolls in the dark.

lines.zh: 我在数展厅里的呼吸声。
lines.en: I count the breathing in the hall.
This suit is badly torn.
I tilt my head toward some sound.

lines.zh: 我不动，灰尘落在我肩上。
lines.en: I stay still and dust settles on me.

lines.zh: 展示台上，我缺着脸看你。
lines.en: On the display stand, I watch you faceless.

lines.zh: 我的手指自己抽了一下。
lines.en: One of my fingers twitches.
The quiet here unsettles me.
I keep watching that door.
Half my face is gone; don't be afraid.
I tilt my head and listen to your heart.

lines.zh: 你的颜色和这里不一样。
lines.en: Your color doesn't match this place.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，手指张得很开。
lines.en: I raise a hand, fingers spread wide.

lines.zh: 你听见我的关节声了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear my joints?
I smell sweat on you.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就偏一下头。
lines.en: You step back, and I tilt my head.
No one should be here at night.
That face. I've torn one like it.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿露在外面，合不上。
lines.en: My teeth show; I can't close them.
Another piece of my suit came off.
That hit the frame.
I tilt, then settle back.
No pain, only instability.
My face is long gone; look.
You broke one of my fingers.
I slowly push my head straight.
Half my face is gone, but I remember you.
I can still walk; don't worry.
My wiring is exposed, and still live.
What's in your hand can't be eaten.
Still, I want to reach for it.
I stare at it a while.
No stomach inside, only wires.
You hold it up; I come closer.
That smell reminds me of someone.
I take it; my hands are stiff.
I'll crush it without meaning to.
I hold it and follow you.
Give it and I won't chase.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你的手臂会疼。
lines.en: Bump me and your arm will hurt.
I am almost never pushed.
My frame is sturdier than you.
You struck my broken edge.

lines.zh: 我侧了侧身，让出半条路。
lines.en: I shift aside, yielding half the way.
Don't press on me; my covering sheds.
The corridor is too narrow for me.
I have you cornered.
The hit knocked my head askew.
You hit me and fall back two steps.

lines.zh: 台上还有另一只旧皮套。
lines.en: Another worn suit stands on the stage.
We both have only half a face.
Two broken dolls against the wall.
She's missing two fingers too.
Only at night do we dare come close.
I raise a hand, and she raises hers.

lines.zh: 灯光在我们中间暗下去。
lines.en: The light dims between us.
In this moment, even machines feel.
By morning we're exhibits again.
I'll remember this night.
I pick it up with stiff fingers.
Whose dropped thing is this?
I squeeze it; it survives.
I put it in a pocket.
My fingers don't quite obey.
Salvaged a few parts from the wreck.

lines.zh: 举到眼前，看不出是什么。
lines.en: Held to my eye — can't tell what it is.
This looks somewhat familiar.
I set it down carefully.
Even this, I can still manage.
The tear in my cloth widens.
I slowly turn my face.

lines.zh: 我的零件掉了两片，还够用。
lines.en: Two parts fell off; enough remains.
The metal hooks at my fingertips spread.
Something flickers in my circuit board.
No one will come to help you.
The smell of rot follows me.
My joints turn notch by notch.
You shut the door. Good.
There's no second way out.
I have no need to run.
A blow given is a blow returned.
I lift my head to your eyes.
Don't shout; the walls are thick.
I'm ready for this one.

lines.zh: 缺了脸皮的兔子，要动手了。
lines.en: The face-less rabbit is ready to swing.
Missing a face, I can still track you.
Wherever you run, I'm there.
My joints sound closer and closer.
Take one look back.
The purple cloth is peeling.
I reach out and draw closer.
My torn ear is still listening.

lines.zh: 我的脸缺了一半，照样走。
lines.en: Half my face is gone and I still walk.
The lights are starting to flicker.
You're standing right in front of the door.

lines.zh: 我听见你抓紧了什么东西。
lines.en: I hear you grip something.
There's no way left behind you.
A little closer is enough.
I raise a hand that's only frame now.
I've stayed outside your sight.
Only two steps remain between us.
Purple scraps drop from my fingers.
Half my face is gone — don't mind it.
Almost at your side.
My broken arm hangs down.
My hand seizes your shoulder.
This one split my own suit.

lines.zh: 我的手指掐进你的衣服。
lines.en: My fingers dig into your clothes.
You're pressed to the floor.

lines.zh: 我的另一只手抬起来了。
lines.en: My other hand is up.
It's wire inside; very hard.
You're flung against the wall.
I look down as you move.
This was no accident.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，差不多要掉了。
lines.en: My head is askew, nearly off.
One joint cracked, dull and heavy.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领往上提。
lines.en: I haul you up by the collar.
The dust on the floor scatters.
You're still moving; stubborn.
I raise my hand to finish it.
The hall goes quiet again.
I slam a palm into your back.
My weight drives you down.
My broken hand swings across.

lines.zh: 这一下，把你的反击打断。
lines.en: This one breaks your counterattack.
I rise slowly out of the dark.
Purple cloth hangs off my joints.
The old wreck has returned.
Half my face is still here.
I come out from behind the stage.
The lights flicker and there I am.
The suit is torn, but I don't fall apart.

lines.zh: 这栋楼晚上的味道没变。
lines.en: The building's night smell hasn't changed.
I flex my fingers slowly.

lines.zh: 我的脸少了一半，还能走。
lines.en: Half my face is gone, and I still walk.
I take my stance, limbs clacking.
I'll do tonight's rounds.

lines.zh: 火沿着旧皮套烧上来，味道很冲。
lines.en: Fire climbs my old suit with a foul smell.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上摔下去，散了一地。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs and scatter.

lines.zh: 水进了我的头壳，什么都听不清。
lines.en: Water fills my head shell and I hear nothing.
The blast tears my hand loose.
An arrow passes through my chest.

lines.zh: 这股力让我一节都动不了。
lines.en: This force locks every joint.
My battery is nearly dead.

lines.zh: 雷击穿了我的框架，抖个不停。
lines.en: Lightning pierces my frame and I keep shaking.

lines.zh: 这里没有地面，我只能往下。
lines.en: No ground here; I can only go down.
